clips.title: Bob's Last Call
clips.blurb: Bob got a pass from upstairs for the whole World Series. Here he calls the final out of the Brewers' first championship, and says goodbye.

clips.title: The Series in Two Minutes
clips.blurb: Five games, twenty-five runs and the first championship in Brewers history, the way Bob remembers it.

clips.title: Game 1 Recap
clips.blurb: Yelich triples in the first, and Megill strikes out the last man with the tying run on third.

clips.title: Game 2 Recap
clips.blurb: The Rays score four in the first. The Brewers shrug, and win anyway.

clips.title: Game 3 Recap
clips.blurb: An eight-run fifth inning, sixteen hits, and one lonely Rays hit off Robert Gasser.

clips.title: Game 4 Recap
clips.blurb: Twelve innings, a Cooper Pratt homer in the twelfth, and a Rays walk-off.

clips.title: Game 5 Recap
clips.blurb: Misiorowski deals, Megill gets the last six outs, and Turang to Bauers makes history.
